rationale: TSEM has already gapped up ~21% and is now trading well below both the session open ($139.76) and VWAP ($138.49), with the last five 1-minute candles showing a sustained fade from the $141.50 high down to the current $135.24 — price is sitting at the absolute low of today's range with heavy selling volume on the most recent candle (233K shares).
